description: A quiet one-line note Baude adds to the chat about what happened around the conversation (resumed, interrupted, a turn's error, the model or folder changed, a denied call…): small, dimmed, left-aligned, selectable, in order with the messages.

parts.name: note
parts.shows: Plain text (not markdown) at 0.85em (font.small), 60% opacity, wrapping, selectable, full column width.

states.name: resumed
states.shows: "— resumed —" where you first wrote to a past session you opened (not on opening it), above your message; "— resumed from network error —" / "— resumed from claude binary error —" when the chat's claude had gone and was started again.

states.name: interrupted
states.shows: "interrupted" once, after a turn you stopped (Esc / stop button), unless a tool card it cut short already says interrupted. Also from history for a stopped turn.

states.name: stop didn't take
states.shows: "claude hadn't stopped after 5s: ended it" or "claude wasn't running: turn ended" ("pi", "Apple's model", "Codex" in place of claude for those).

states.name: turn error
states.shows: "turn ended with error: <what claude said>" (unless the reply already showed that error as an API error line). For a chat whose folder is gone on another host: "<why>: start a new chat in <folder> on <host> to carry on".

states.name: settings changed
states.shows: "model → <model>" (": a new conversation" when it had to start afresh), "thinking effort → <level>", "permission mode → <mode>", "folder → <path>" (" (conversation continues)"), "claude is running in <path>".

states.name: other
states.shows: Host and process notes ("Starting <machine>'s host process…", "failed to start claude: …", "couldn't reach <host>: …"), attach/paste failures ("can't attach <path>: not a file", "paste failed: …"), "stop requested for <task>", "control error: …", "stderr: <line>", and unknown system events as "[system:<subtype>]".
